checks.details: npm run blockchain:compile completed without errors. No contracts to compile (stub state).
TypeScript noEmit verification: all files compile correctly. No type errors.
All TypeScript types properly defined in dapp/src/types/agrochain.ts: BuyerProfile, PurchaseOrder, DeliveryStatus, ProducerReview, Review exported and used correctly.

FIXED: All hardcoded hex colors replaced with CSS variable references. Status colors now use --status-aguardando, --status-emitido, --status-transportando, --status-entregue, --status-rejeitado and their -bg variants.
FIXED: getStatusColor() and getStatusBgColor() refactored to use Record<string, string> maps with var(--status-*) tokens. Removed 10+ hardcoded hex values (#b8912a, #1f6f9e, #1f6440, #a83226, etc.).
FIXED: Replaced #d1e4d8 hardcoded border/hover color with var(--verde-100) and var(--verde-300) for hover state. Uses CSS variables for all button styling.
FIXED: Replaced #d1e4d8 border with var(--verde-100). Button hover now uses var(--verde-300) for consistent token-based styling.
FIXED: 'Confirmar Entrega' button now uses var(--verde-100) and var(--verde-300). 'Rejeitar Pedido' button uses var(--status-rejeitado-bg) and var(--status-rejeitado).
FIXED: Replaced hardcoded #fff (white) with var(--sup-1) for select and textarea backgrounds. Button styling uses CSS variables throughout.
Mock data present and comprehensive: MOCK_PURCHASE_ORDERS (12+ orders), MOCK_REVIEWS (5+ reviews), MOCK_PRODUCERS (8+ producers). Data varies by status.
Filters in /buyer/orders functional: date range, status dropdown, producer search. Pagination resets on filter change.
Sidebar.tsx verified: COMPRADOR section with 3 links. shouldSectionBeExpanded() correctly maps to ['/buyer'].
Headings use var(--serifa). Body uses var(--fonte). Spacing uses var(--e-*) tokens. border-radius uses var(--raio) variants.
Labels properly associated. Semantic HTML used. Status chips use both color AND text.
Grids use auto-fit and minmax for responsive columns. Mobile-friendly sizes.
All pages use 'use client' directive. Proper React hooks. No console errors. Follows project patterns.
